_comment: Domain facts for message-center-monitor. Lock in column types, option-set mappings, entity-set names, and the C1 invariant location so future agents do not re-introduce the fsi_assessedby Lookup mistake or any of the other known foot-guns. Read this BEFORE editing any script in this solution. See also docs/dataverse-schema.md (auto-generated from scripts/create_mcm_dataverse_schema.py).
domainFacts: fsi_assessedby is a String column (StringAttributeMetadata, MaxLength 200), NOT a Lookup. Never use _fsi_assessedby_value OData syntax - it returns 400 Bad Request. See scripts/create_mcm_dataverse_schema.py for the schema definition.

Dataverse logical names are the SchemaName lowercased with NO underscores inserted between words. fsi_AssessedBy -> fsi_assessedby (NOT fsi_assessed_by); fsi_MessageCenterId -> fsi_messagecenterid; fsi_AssessmentStatus -> fsi_assessmentstatus.
_<column>_value OData syntax is Lookup-only. For String, Choice (OptionSet), DateTime, Boolean, or any non-Lookup column, use the plain column name in $select and $filter.
Severity option set values: 100000000=High, 100000001=Normal, 100000002=Critical. See scripts/create_mcm_dataverse_schema.py. Common mistake: assuming 0=Normal, 1=High - wrong.
Category option set values: 100000000=Feature, 100000001=Admin, 100000002=Security. See scripts/create_mcm_dataverse_schema.py.
Assessment status option set values: 100000000=NotAssessed, 100000001=Reviewed, 100000002=ImpactsAgents, 100000003=NoImpact. See scripts/create_mcm_dataverse_schema.py.
Entity set name (table name in OData URL): fsi_messagecenterlogs (plural with 's'). Table SchemaName is fsi_MessageCenterLog (singular). See _Common.ps1 for the dvBaseUrl construction.

Admin-owned columns (the C1 invariant - NEVER clobbered by the Graph sync): fsi_assessmentstatus, fsi_assessment, fsi_assessedby, fsi_assesseddate, fsi_actionstaken, fsi_impactsagents, fsi_notifiedon.

C1 enforcement location: Invoke-McmDvUpsertMessage in scripts/governance/_Common.ps1 deliberately rejects admin-owned columns in the $Record parameter. The invariant is verified by a STATIC REGEX TEST in tests/Sync.Tests.ps1 (lines 39-62) - NOT tests/Guards.Tests.ps1.

Direct PATCH for admin-owned columns: when an admin column must be written from a governance script (e.g. fsi_notifiedon after a successful Teams notification), bypass Invoke-McmDvUpsertMessage and use Invoke-McmRest with a targeted single-field body. See Invoke-MessageCenterSync.ps1 for the canonical example.

PowerShell governance scripts authenticate via Get-McmAccessToken in scripts/governance/_Common.ps1. Modes: ManagedIdentity (default and preferred), WorkloadIdentity, Interactive, DeviceCode, ClientSecret. ClientSecret is the POC fallback only - migrate to certificate or workload identity federation before production.

Phase 1 (PowerShell webhook in Invoke-MessageCenterSync.ps1) and Phase 3 (Power Automate flow described in docs/flow-configuration.md) are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE notification paths. fsi_notifiedon provides per-row idempotency within ONE path only - it is NOT cross-path dedup. Test-McmPrerequisites.ps1 check #11 enforces the exclusion at deploy time.
Schema documentation at docs/dataverse-schema.md is AUTO-GENERATED. Edit scripts/create_mcm_dataverse_schema.py and re-run with --output-docs to regenerate; do not hand-edit the markdown.
site-docs/solutions/message-center-monitor/ is gitignored. Never edit there - it is regenerated by scripts/build-manifest.py from manifest.yaml and the per-solution docs/ folder.

Teams Office 365 connector webhooks were retired by Microsoft in 2026-Q1. Use Teams Workflows incoming webhook (the 'Post to a channel when a webhook request is received' template). The shared Adaptive Card template at templates/teams-notification-card.json (Adaptive Card schema 1.5) is rendered by BOTH the Phase 1 PowerShell sync and the Phase 3 Power Automate flow - do not rename tokens or restructure the body without coordinating both paths.

Adaptive card tokens supplied by the Phase 1 PowerShell sync: severity, title, category, services, startDateTime, actionRequiredByDateTime, id, environment, appId, publisherPrefix, recordId. recordId comes from the Dataverse upsert response body (fsi_messagecenterlogid), which requires 'Prefer: return=representation' on the request headers - already set by _Common.ps1.

Governance scripts that make HTTP calls (anything under scripts/governance/ except _Common.ps1) MUST dot-source _Common.ps1 AND route ALL HTTP through Invoke-McmRest (not Invoke-RestMethod, not Invoke-WebRequest). Enforced by tests/Guards.Tests.ps1. Az CLI is forbidden in governance scripts; use the Az.KeyVault module instead. Both rules are enforced by tests/Guards.Tests.ps1.
